mapper.sql: NULLIF( MIN( LEAST( COALESCE(r.rate_range1, 999.99), COALESCE(r.rate_range2, 999.99), COALESCE(r.rate_range3, 999.99), COALESCE(r.rate_range4, 999.99), COALESCE(r.rate_range5, 999.99), COALESCE(r.rate_range6, 999.99), COALESCE(r.rate_range7, 999.99), COALESCE(r.rate_range8, 999.99) ) ), 999.99 ) AS minRate, NULLIF( MAX( GREATEST( COALESCE(r.rate_range1, 0), COALESCE(r.rate_range2, 0), COALESCE(r.rate_range3, 0), COALESCE(r.rate_range4, 0), COALESCE(r.rate_range5, 0), COALESCE(r.rate_range6, 0), COALESCE(r.rate_range7, 0), COALESCE(r.rate_range8, 0) ) ), 0 ) AS maxRate
mapper.select: SELECT l.loan_id AS loanId, l.industry_id AS industryId, l.region_id AS regionId, l.company_name AS companyName, l.product_name AS productName, l.join_way AS joinWay, l.begin_date AS beginDate, l.end_date AS endDate, l.product_page_url AS productPageUrl, l.min_limit AS minLimit, l.max_limit AS maxLimit, l.basic_rate AS basicRate, COALESCE(lsc.scrap_count, 0) AS bookmarkCount FROM loans l INNER JOIN business_info bi ON bi.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN loan_scrap_counts lsc ON l.loan_id = lsc.loan_id WHERE (l.region_id IS NULL OR l.region_id = bi.region_id) AND (l.industry_id IS NULL OR l.industry_id = bi.industry_id) ORDER BY bookmarkCount DESC, l.basic_rate ASC -- 즐겨찾기 많은 순, 같다면 금리 낮은 순
SELECT rate_id, rate_type, average_rate, rate_range1, rate_range2, rate_range3, rate_range4, rate_range5, rate_range6, rate_range7, rate_range8 FROM rates WHERE loan_id = #{loanId}
